name: F-1 frag grenade
description: Defensive fragmentation grenade. Throw it at the reticle (a hotkey or the hotkey wheel): it goes off 3 s after the pin is pulled and hurts everyone in the open within 7 m, most up close.

name: Zarya flashbang
description: Stun grenade. Throw it at the reticle (a hotkey or the hotkey wheel): a blinding flash and a bang 1.6 s later, worst for anyone looking at it.
